einzeiler: A clinical breakdown of the 1995 coming-of-age classic Now & Then.
kurzfassung: Licensed therapists psychoanalyze the 1995 nostalgic film Now & Then, examining the childhood struggles and adult lives of its four main characters. They explore themes of grief, family dynamics, childhood development, and the importance of female friendships. The hosts also discuss the psychological impact of parental absence and how children process trauma.
stichpunkte: Introduction to the 1995 coming-of-age movie Now & Then and its main characters
Analysis of Roberta's tomboy persona, early puberty, and complex grief over losing her mother
Discussion of Teeny's experience as an only child with emotionally neglectful parents
Examination of Samantha's cynicism, coping mechanisms, and her parents' divorce
Review of Chrissy's upbringing under a perfectionist mother and her adherence to traditional standards
Therapeutic perspectives on how children process trauma through play and distraction
Therapeutic treatment approaches using internal family systems and client-centered therapy
Final thoughts on the film's enduring portrayal of female friendship and adolescent development

[Content Warning: some discussion of suicide]

Join us as we disect the 1995 classic, Now And Then! We discuss each of the movie's four main characters: Roberta, Teeny, Samantha, and Chrissy. We explore each of the girl's struggles, be it the death of a parent, going through the first divorce in the neighborhood, or trying to get your parents' attention. We discuss how their childhood experiences have influenced their presentation as adults. We hope you enjoy!
